# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Na sãa seeda (Yareru), nɛn gusunɔ, mɛ a man taka kuawa na n nun yɛ ̃ kpa na n nun saamɔ. Tɛ ̃ na yɔ̃ mi na nɛn dam sariru yɛ,̃ ma na wunɛn yiko yɛ arumani yɛ ̃ Gusunɔ goo maa sari ma n kun wunɛ, wunɛ wi a ra faaba ko gɔban di—Wunɛ wi a wãa wunɛn tii sɔɔ.
